content: I regret purchasing this foam mattress—it feels like sleeping on a slab of concrete. The advertised "luxurious comfort" is a complete lie; after one night, I woke up with stiffness in my back and shoulders. Within a week, the center started developing a noticeable sag, even though I'm under 150 pounds. The chemical smell that came with it took over a month to fade, and it still lingers slightly. It traps heat so badly that I wake up sweating every single night. Motion isolation is non-existent—my partner's every move jolts me awake. Customer service was unhelpful when I requested a return, citing “buyer’s remorse” policies. Save your money and your spine—avoid this mattress like the plague.
